definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 defines report as 'A printed output described in the report section and generated from those data descriptions'; 2023 drops the definition and reaches the same object through the RD and the REPORT clause (§2023:13.18.46.1). Same object in both editions, so the control and report footings TERMINATE prints are the same groups; scope and evidence unchanged.
